name: Balaeno Video Popup Player
author: balaeno

sections.description:
Balaeno Video Popup Player helps site owners show an engaging video popup on standard site pages and product pages.

The plugin lets you select a video from the WordPress Media Library and display it in a responsive floating popup. You can control where the popup appears, adjust desktop and mobile sizes, set margins, choose device visibility, and enable or disable the popup for WordPress pages and WooCommerce product pages.

The free plugin is fully functional on its own and does not require an external service, license key, paid account, or remote connection to operate.

A separate premium plugin is available outside WordPress.org for users who need advanced capabilities such as assigning or mapping different videos to individual WordPress pages or WooCommerce products. The premium plugin is optional and is not required for the free plugin to work.

Features

  • Display one global video popup across WordPress pages and WooCommerce product pages.
  • Select a self-hosted video from the WordPress Media Library.
  • Enable or disable display on WooCommerce product pages.
  • Enable or disable display on standard WordPress pages.
  • Configure desktop and mobile popup width and height.
  • Position the popup at the top, middle, or bottom and left, center, or right.
  • Control horizontal and vertical margins.
  • Choose desktop-only, mobile-only, or both-device visibility.
  • Privacy-friendly: no data is collected, stored, or sent to external servers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/balaeno-video-popup-player directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Video Player in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Choose a video from the Media Library.
  5. Configure where the popup should appear and save your settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

No. The plugin can display the video popup on standard WordPress pages. If WooCommerce is installed, it can also display on WooCommerce product pages.

Does the free plugin require a license key?

No. The free plugin does not require a license key, external account, or paid service.

Can I assign a different video to each page or product?

The free plugin displays one global video based on your settings. A separate premium plugin is available for mapping different videos to individual pages and products.

Does this plugin collect data?

No. The plugin does not collect, store, or transmit visitor data to external servers.
